## Problem

Evaluating autonomous agents for experimental orchestration on real laboratory hardware is slow and expensive. Progress on planning, fault recovery, and decision-making needs simulation environments and benchmarks that support controlled offline study.

## Approach

I am building **CloudBench**, an open-framework simulator and benchmark generator for programmable cloud laboratories. The laboratory setting is the application domain; the research questions are about simulation, agent evaluation, and benchmarking for autonomous systems.

## Status

Manuscript in preparation. Code and benchmarks will be released with the paper.
